AF1774 सदनं मनसः sadanaṁ manasaḥ Loss of mental strength.
AF1772 सदाहं पुरीषप्रवर्तनं sadāhaṁ purīṣapravartanaṁ Defecation with burning sensation
AF1775 सदोषं पुरीषं sadoṣaṁ purīṣaṁ Undigested stool.
AT0279 सद्यप्राणहर धूम sadyaprāṇahara dhūma Harmful smoke/fumes from a preparation which turn out to be fatal almost instantaneously.

SV0229 सद्वृत्त sadvṛtta The good conduct/behaviour of man. It can be expressed as right conducts or good conducts or moral conducts which are followed to lead healthy life. Conducts which are good at physical, good at mental and good at verbal are called as Sadvritta.
AT0273 साद sāda Depression, It is a symptom produced in first impulse of animal poisoning.
